messages:
Jordan: Hey all — PR #4571 is ready for review, changes to split-cache eviction and auth header ordering. Need runtime + infra + security signoff and a merge slot this week. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4571 :link:

Priya: @Jordan :eyes: quick skim looks fine but left a comment on the kv expiry check (possible race). Sam can you take the deeper look? I/O path changed.

Sam: taking it now. I have a local repro for the kv race, will try a patch by EOD. If I can't reproduce after your comment I'll add a test.

Kai: FYI infra perf team — we'll need a short perf run on staging (1000 qps for 1m) if this goes to canary. Can we schedule a 30m canary window? Prefer Thurs 9–9:30 PT.

Jordan: Thurs 9 PT works for me. I can generate the perf traces and heap profiles ahead of time. I included a small snippet of the new eviction config in the PR:
```
eviction:
  policy: split-prefetch
  ttl_ms: 60000
  max_shards: 128
```

Marta: Security checklist — I went thru auth header ordering change. Two asks: (1) add a unit test that validates header canonicalization, (2) confirm no header leakage to logs. If both good, :thumbsup: from security.

Sam: working on the unit test now. Will also grep for `logger.*auth` to ensure nothing prints auth headers.

deploy-bot: CI passed — 12/12 checks. build/test/coverage all green.

Priya: once Sam updates tests, I can give runtime approval. Can someone assign Sam as reviewer? @Kai can you confirm perf slot?

Kai: Confirmed, Thurs 09:00 PT reserved. I'll kick off the staging run and post results in this thread.

Jordan: thanks team — assigning Sam, and tagging Marta for final sec signoff after tests. If all green we'll aim to merge Thurs 10:00 PT (after canary)

Marta: noted. Ping me here after canary and I'll do final :ok_hand:

Jordan: awesome — appreciate the quick turnaround :wave:
